svg.text: Wall elevations: each wall seen from inside the shop, as you stand facing it (metres)
1. LEFT WALL as you enter (the +x wall). Glass front on the left, back wall on the right.
2. RIGHT WALL as you enter (the -x wall). Glass front on the right, back wall on the left.
3. BACK WALL, shop side (z = +7.9), seen facing it. The +x side is on the left.
service bar in front of the wall
4. FRONT GLASS WALL (z = -8), seen from inside facing it. The +x side is on the right.
full-height glass (entrance door position not yet modelled: [TK])
17 m overall (shop 16 m between the side walls)
Not drawn: back-room walls (the shelving rows and repair benches are on the plan). Wall colours are the three tones in the first elevation.
